content.short: Mode is a high-performance OP-Stack L2 network on Ethereum focusing on Decentralized AI Finance (DeFAI) and rewarding developers.
content.description: Mode is a high-performance Ethereum Layer 2 network built using the Optimism OP Stack, serving as a core member of the "Superchain" ecosystem. The network is specifically designed to foster ecosystem growth by rewarding both users and developers through innovative mechanisms like Contract Secured Revenue (CSR), which allows developers to earn a portion of the network's transaction fees. Recently, Mode has pivoted to become a premier destination for Decentralized AI Finance (DeFAI), supporting verifiable AI agents for on-chain trading. Powered by the MODE token, the network provides a scalable and cost-effective environment for DeFi and AI applications.
content.meta: Mode is an Ethereum Layer 2 network focused on DeFAI and developer-aligned revenue sharing. Discover Mode on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
